messages:
sara.support: FYI — ACME's onboarding ticket #5678: they clicked redeem, UI showed success, webhook was ACKed, but their org balance is still $0. Can someone triage? https://support.redwood.ai/t/5678

promo-webhook-bot: Webhook received for redeem_event:
```
grant_id: G-9f3
org_id: org_acme
billing_account_id: acct_0012
amount_cents: 50000
status: accepted
source: webflow
received_at: 2026-03-16T22:04:08Z
```

aj.billing: On it. Can you confirm the org_id and billing_account_id from the ticket (if different from the webhook)? I'll check the grants table and ledger ingestion.

sara.support: Confirmed from customer email: org=org_acme, billing=acct_0012. They have screenshots: UI shows green check but balance still 0. Attaching ticket thread.

mike.ops: Ran quick query against grants: 
```
SELECT grant_id, mapped_billing_account, applied_at, status
FROM grants
WHERE grant_id='G-9f3';
```
Result: `mapped_billing_account = NULL`, `applied_at = NULL`, `status = "accepted"` — so webhook created a grant record but mapping step didn't attach billing account, ledger worker skips unmapped grants.

ines.product: Looking at grant-mapper logs around 22:04:08Z: `grant-mapper` attempted to call Billing API `POST /map-grant` and received a 504 gateway timeout, then it marked the grant as "mapping_pending" but the retry job didn't pick it up because of a bad queue key. Snippet: 
```
2026-03-16T22:04:09Z grant-mapper ERROR grant_id=G-9f3 map call failed: timeout (504)
2026-03-16T22:04:09Z grant-mapper INFO grant_id=G-9f3 state=mapping_pending queue_key=null
```

aj.billing: That explains it. If `mapped_billing_account` is NULL, ledger apply is a no-op. Quick remediation: set the mapping and trigger ledger apply. Commands (ops privileges required):
```
# set mapping
bin/grantctl set-mapping --grant G-9f3 --billing acct_0012
# run ledger worker for this grant
bin/ledgerctl apply-grant --grant G-9f3
```

mike.ops: Executed both commands. `grantctl` returned `200 OK`, then `ledgerctl` processed tokens. Ledger entries created: `credit 50000 cents -> org_acme (ledger_tx 98765)`. Checked account balance endpoint: `GET /accounts/acct_0012/balance` returns `50000` cents.

sara.support: I pinged the customer with screenshots. They confirm balance now shows $500.00 in the console. They appreciate the quick fix.

ines.product: To avoid recurrence, I pushed a hotfix to grant-mapper to retry on 5xx/timeouts and to write a non-null queue_key even on transient errors. Follow-up ticket created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1023 (label: postmortem-needed).

aj.billing: I'll run a backfill to find other grants with `mapped_billing_account IS NULL AND status='accepted'` in the last 48h and trigger the reassign/apply flow. Will report back in the morning.

mike.ops: Thumbs up. Logged a short incident note and marked ticket #5678 resolved. Closing thread. :tada:
